$comment: Where a surviving mutant fails the run (issue 1269, owner's scope change of 6 Nov 2026): imports, deletes, download clients, the processor hand-off and anything that touches files on disk. Elsewhere the mutation score is published and may only go up, but survivors do not fail the push. `projects` makes every file of a .NET project risky; `files` makes one folder or file risky (a path as the Stryker report spells it, matched at a folder boundary). A survivor in a risky file passes only when docs/testing/mutation-equivalents.json lists it with the reason no test can kill it.

projects.Deluno.Filesystem: imports, file moves, deletes, hardlinks, the processor hand-off output and every other touch of files on disk
projects.Deluno.Connections: download client and indexer connections, their sign-in and credentials
projects.Deluno.Retention: what the retention rules decide to delete
projects.Deluno.Companions: installing and wiring the download clients and the processor on disk

files.why: talks to every download client: grabs, removals, save folders, strikes
backup and restore write and delete files
data folder checks and staged restores delete and replace files
